title: Deno 1.x is end-of-life
summary: Deno 1.x was superseded by Deno 2.0 (released October 2024). Deno 1.x is end-of-life and no longer receives feature updates or bug fixes.

constraints: Upgrade to Deno 2.0 or later while verifying compatibility with Deno 2 breaking changes.

steps.title: Upgrade Deno runtime
steps.instructions: Update the Deno version pin in deno.json, deno.jsonc, or environment setup to Deno 2.0 or later.
